reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message. I couldn't confirm that Bay 15 is the site for the Jasper rollout at Marrow Fieldworks.

Nothing in #central-team or the public files mentions a Jasper rollout or Bay 15. The only Marrow Fieldworks site detail I found is in the January 2026 handoff digest. It mentions Bay 4 at the Salina North yard under ticket #4409, which has nothing to do with Jasper. I told Tobias to treat Bay 15 as a rumour until the Marrow Fieldworks account owner confirms it. I didn't save it anywhere as a fact.
